title: CI attested-footprint request (POST <BASE>/ci/footprint)
description: Sent by a pipeline (project token) with the files changed on a branch since its divergence point from the base — the ATTESTED footprint, a fact valid for humans too. Paths are repo-relative, one entry per file. Missing required fields → HTTP 400 {"error": ...}. Answer: {ok, entries, worksiteId?, issueKey?}.

branch.description: Branch whose footprint is attested. REQUIRED.

baseBranch.description: Divergence base. The file list SHOULD be computed since the merge-base with this branch, so an integration branch does not inflate the footprint.

paths.description: Accepted alternative to files: one path per line.

issueKey.description: Ticket key, when the pipeline knows it; otherwise derived from the branch.

prOpen.description: A pull request is open for this branch. Strings 'true'/'false' are accepted.

prApproved.description: The pull request is approved (merge is close). Strings 'true'/'false' are accepted.
